$comment: Repo nay la san pham tieng Viet: comment viet tieng Viet KHONG DAU (quy uoc
san co), con chuoi hien thi va du lieu mau thi tieng Viet CO DAU.
Trinh kiem tra chinh ta tieng Anh doc chung thanh tu sai va sinh ra hang tram
canh bao gia trong tab PROBLEMS, lam lap mat loi that.
Cach xu ly: bo qua dung ba vung chac chan la tieng Viet, giu nguyen kiem tra
chinh ta cho ten bien, ten ham va chuoi tieng Anh - noi loi go that dang duoc bat.
1. Comment       - toan bo phan dien giai bang tieng Viet khong dau
2. Chuoi co dau  - chuoi chua ky tu co dau phu (U+00C0-U+1EF9) chac chan la
tieng Viet, vd 'Đóng khung chat'. Bo qua ca chuoi, vi
trong do co ca am tiet vo tinh khong dau (khung, trang).
3. Slug kebab    - gia tri enum tieng Viet dang 'phan-khu', 'mac-dinh',
'dang-mo-ban'. Chi khop chuoi toan chu thuong co dau noi.
